title: Fun tour to Cordoba from Seville.
text:
The tour to Cordoba was very well planned by the tour guide. Andres was on time to pick us up at our hotel in Seville and was very good with all communication. He worked very hard to ensure we had a great time. He got us a reservation for lunch at a lovely local restaurant. The tour of the Mosque was informative. Such a unique building with tons of history. The walking tour of Cordoba with Tanya also was loaded with history. She did an excellent job taking us to the city highlights. 

Overall, an excellent tour and well worth the money. Excellent communication, everything went on time and fabu
author: Maura_H

title: Let Carlos help guide you through Cordoba! You won’t regret it!
text: Carlos was an exceptional guide to Cordoba! He picked us up in Seville and brought us to Cordoba, where his knowledge, expertise, and friendliness made our experience of the city so memorable. We really recommend Carlos! Five stars across the board!
author: marclI5405HS

title: Time well spent
text:
We had a wonderful tour with our guide Carlos. 
Highly recommend if taking this tour, to ask for Carlos.
He is extremely knowledgeable, professional & really nice.
It was a great day & tour.
author: icooppit

title: Great day in Cordoba!
text: Had a beautiful day in Cordoba with our driver and guide, Joan. He was very knowledgeable and made sure all our needs were met! Highly recommend!
author: W871KWlisaw

title: Adapted trip to Cordoba
text:
Our driver, Joan, and our guide, Angel, were excellent for this day trip to Cordoba. Our family had a great time, and they were very understanding of our elderly mom's needs, wheelchair, and adapted as necessary. Lunch recommendations were perfect and we returned to Seville in time for a great Tapas dinner.

Highly recommend this tour and operator. I had great interactions with Mahsa of Not Just a Tourist.
author: CaleB323

title: History and culture
text: Excellent, and our guide great. Very pleasant and knowledgeable talk. Friendly and glad to what he does. The wonderful tour and more inside the alcazar of Cordova, Angel with extensive knowledge of the site. It is a cultural delight!!
author: Malu_C

title: Our Day in Cordoba
text: It was very interesting.  Our guides were very knowledgeable and helpful during the entire trip.  The mosque was very nice with its red and white archways.
author: JP_F

title: Great Day Trip from Seville
text:
We booked a tour to Cordoba and the Mosque well in advance. Not Just a Tourist was easy to communicate with and gave us an option for a private tour inside the Mosque for an extra fee (which we chose).

Carlos picked us up at our hotel 10 minutes early in a very comfortable Ford Puma. We made two stops on our way to Cordoba. First stop was at the Parador de Carmona Hotel - Alcazar del Rey Don Pedro. title: Great Day Trip To Cordoba!
text: Great day excursion to Cordoba - we saw all the highlights and got a great feel for the city thanks to our wonderful tour guide Carlos. We also highly recommend the private/small group tour of the mosque. Definitely worth it!
